fields.description: These overrides change how Frappe's desk behaves and depend on details of its code that an upgrade can change, so switch them off first if the desk misbehaves after an upgrade. Changes apply when each user reloads the page.
fields.label: Override Dock

fields.description: Turns the Dock, the column left of the sidebar, into a dock of apps: the Desk Apps, then each installed app Frappe lists on its Apps screen, with every module left over under Other. Where its modules are shown, what picking an app does, and showing it on mobile are the settings it brings with it.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description:
Where an app's modules are shown:
  • Module Menu: the menu at the top of the sidebar lists the app's modules. The sidebar always holds the module's content.
  • App Menu: as Frappe's own dock: the app's mark at the top and its modules under it, one icon each. The mark opens a menu of the apps, in place of the Apps screen.
  • Sliding Sidebar: the sidebar's rows become the app's modules when you pick the app, until you pick one; a row at the top of a module's content goes back to the list.
  • Module Tabs: the modules are tabs in a band across the top, over the sidebar and the page, with the app's name first. Tabs that do not fit go under More.
  • Three Column: the modules get a column of their own between the dock and the sidebar. It folds to icons and opens over the sidebar while pointed at.
  • Accordion Dock: the open app's tile opens up on the dock to show its modules under it, one icon each; clicking the open app folds them away.
  • Accordion Sidebar: the sidebar lists the app's modules as headings, the open module's content under its own.
Below 768px, Module Tabs and Three Column pick from the menu at the top of the sidebar, and so do App Menu and Accordion Dock when the dock is not shown on mobile.

fields.description:
What picking an app on the dock does, whichever Layout:
  • Show Its Modules: shows the app's modules over the page you are on, until you pick one; Escape, a click elsewhere, or another page puts them away.
  • Open Last Module: goes into the app, to the module last open in it in this browser (its first, the first time). Picking the app you are already in shows its modules.
  • Open Last Sidebar Item: the same, but to the sidebar item last open in the app, such as a list or a report, rather than its module's home; to the last module where there is none.

fields.description: Below 768px, where the sidebar is a drawer opened from the button at the top left of the page, shows the dock in the drawer, left of the sidebar, so apps are picked there as on a wider screen. Turned off, the dock is hidden on phones, as Frappe hides it, and the menu at the top of the sidebar lists the apps.
fields.label: Show Dock on Mobile

fields.description: Arranges the icons on Frappe's Apps screen (/desk) from the Desk Apps, in dock order, as each Desk App's Apps Screen setting says. Only where Desktop Settings' Desktop Page is Apps: Frappe's older Desktop Icons grid is left as Frappe draws it. Turned off, Frappe's own Apps screen comes back.
fields.label: Enabled
Move Other Apps' Tiles to Dock
fields.description: Frappe puts Search and Notifications on the dock while it is pinned. This puts the tiles other apps add beside them at the top of the sidebar (such as To Do) on the dock with them, and opens all their drawers beside the dock, over the sidebar. Turned off, those tiles stay in the sidebar. Needs Override Dock to be enabled.

fields.label: Move Search and Notifications to Bottom of Dock
fields.description: Puts Search, Notifications, and any tiles other apps add beside them at the bottom of the dock, above the user menu, rather than at the top, under the site's logo. Needs Override Dock to be enabled.
Moves Help and the site's tools (the Navbar Settings rows, such as System Console) from the menu at the top of the sidebar into the user menu, above Logout.
fields.label: Move Help and Site Tools to User Menu
